title: Tour lab stages
summary: How the circuit is set up: stage types, overdue days, alerts and deactivated stages.

steps.title: Menu → Business Setup → Lab Stages
steps.details: The stages every lab order goes through, in order.

steps.title: Active stages
steps.details: In workflow order; drag the handle on the left to reorder. There is a single initial stage, where every new order starts, and at least one final stage. The days mark when an order in that stage is overdue; in the stage an order is sent to, they suggest the due date.

steps.title: Stage alerts
steps.details: The bell shows how many alerts it has: when an order arrives and if it is overdue (by the stage days or, where it was sent, by the due date).

steps.title: Deactivated stages
steps.details: A stage that had orders is not deleted: it is deactivated and can be reactivated.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: List changes apply when you save, all together.
